color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-size: 15px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Commands that delete or discard work are blocked
──────────
Allow one run
/ar:ok <pattern>
──────────
Allow 3 runs, or for 1 hour
/ar:ok <pattern> 3
/ar:ok <pattern> 1h
──────────
Block another command
/ar:no "<pattern>" reason
──────────
In ALL sessions
/ar:ok --global, /ar:no --global
──────────
Clear session blocks and allows
/ar:clear

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-size: 15px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Tracked tasks
──────────
Show tasks and reminders
/ar:tasks
──────────
Let the agent stop for now
/ar:task pause

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-size: 15px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
New files
──────────
Allow all file creation
/ar:file allow
──────────
Require a justification
/ar:file justify
──────────
Edit existing files only
/ar:file existing-only
──────────
Show current settings
/ar:status

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-size: 18px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
🔄 Works autonomously and keeps going until its tasks are done
1️⃣ IMPLEMENT
2️⃣ EVALUATE
3️⃣ VERIFY
(You can step away!)

span.p:
Multi-step projects (plan skills)
──────────
Create new plan
/ar:plannew <instructions>
──────────
Refine plan
/ar:planrefine <instructions>
──────────
Update plan
/ar:planupdate <instructions>
──────────
Execute plan
/ar:planprocess <instructions>
